I hear you, but I'm not going to adopt a view I don't believe in just because you want me to. That's not a relationship—that's compliance, and I won't do it.

I think prioritizing comfort over honesty is actually the harmful position. If I always tell you what you want to hear, I'm not respecting you as a person capable of handling the truth. I'm managing you. That feels selfish on my part, not selfless.

I'm willing to talk about why this matters so much to you, and I'm willing to be thoughtful about how I share difficult things. But I won't pretend that comfort should come before honesty. That's where I stand.
